title: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
summary: Moves the interim Fundamental Rights report and asks the Assembly to settle constitutional principles before final legal drafting.

title: Hriday Nath Kunzru
summary: Questions whether every proposition placed among enforceable rights genuinely belongs there, including residence, settlement and trade questions.

title: P. R. Thakur
summary: Presses for stronger constitutional treatment of economic inequality and connects the abolition of untouchability with the deeper caste structure.

title: Somnath Lahiri
summary: Challenges the report's division of rights and argues that restrictions and emergency qualifications leave excessive room for state power.

title: R. K. Sidhwa
summary: Emphasises that the report is interim and argues that economic and political rights have not disappeared from constitutional consideration.

title: N. G. Ranga
summary: Defends safeguards against authoritarian abuse, treats freedom of expression as protecting the press and stresses practical access to constitutional remedies.
